<?php
function yn(bool $b): string
{
    return $b ? "yes" : "no";
}
function mark(array $m): string
{
    return "(" . implode(",", array_map(fn($x) => $x < 0 ? "w" : (string) $x, $m)) . ")";
}
function listed(array $a): string
{
    return $a ? implode(" ", $a) : "none";
}
function number(string $s, int $lo, int $hi): int
{
    return preg_match("/\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,9})\z/D", $s) && (int) $s >= $lo && (int) $s <= $hi
        ? (int) $s
        : -1;
}
function bad(string $s): never
{
    throw new RuntimeException($s);
}
function visit(array $adj, int $start): array
{
    $seen = array_fill(0, count($adj), false);
    $q = [$start];
    $seen[$start] = true;
    for ($i = 0; $i < count($q); ++$i) {
        foreach ($adj[$q[$i]] as $v) {
            if (!$seen[$v]) {
                $seen[$v] = true;
                $q[] = $v;
            }
        };
    }
    return $seen;
}
function flows(array $a): array
{
    $n = count($a);
    $m = count($a[0]);
    $rows = [];
    foreach ($a as $i => $r) {
        for ($j = 0; $j < $n; ++$j) {
            $r[] = (int) ($i === $j);
        }
        $rows[] = $r;
    }
    $gcd = function (int $a, int $b) use (&$gcd): int {
        return $b ? $gcd($b, $a % $b) : abs($a);
    };
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; ++$j) {
        $all = [];
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            if ($r[$j] === 0) {
                $all[implode(",", $r)] = $r;
            }
        }
        foreach ($rows as $r) {
            if ($r[$j] > 0) {
                foreach ($rows as $s) {
                    if ($s[$j] < 0) {
                        $v = [];
                        $d = 0;
                        foreach ($r as $k => $x) {
                            $v[$k] = -$s[$j] * $x + $r[$j] * $s[$k];
                            $d = $gcd($d, $v[$k]);
                        }
                        foreach ($v as &$x) {
                            $x = intdiv($x, $d);
                        }
                        unset($x);
                        $all[implode(",", $v)] = $v;
                    }
                };
            }
        }
        $all = array_values($all);
        $supports = [];
        foreach ($all as $r) {
            $mask = 0;
            for ($i = 0; $i < $n; ++$i) {
                if ($r[$m + $i] > 0) {
                    $mask |= 1 << $i;
                }
            }
            $supports[] = $mask;
        }
        $rows = [];
        foreach ($all as $i => $r) {
            $minimal = true;
            foreach ($supports as $s) {
                if ($s !== $supports[$i] && ($s & $supports[$i]) === $s) {
                    $minimal = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ($minimal) {
                $rows[] = $r;
            }
        }
    }
    $result = array_map(fn($r) => array_slice($r, $m), $rows);
    usort($result, fn($a, $b) => $b <=> $a);
    return $result;
}
final class Net
{
    public array $p = [],
        $t = [],
        $initial = [],
        $cap = [],
        $priority = [],
        $current = [],
        $history = [],
        $pre = [],
        $post = [],
        $inh = [];
    public int $arcs = 0,
        $inhibitors = 0;
    public function __construct(public string $name)
    {
        $this->pre = $this->post = $this->inh = array_fill(0, 16, array_fill(0, 16, 0));
    }
    public function define(array $w): void
    {
        $cmd = $w[0];
        $n = count($w) - 1;
        if (!in_array($cmd, ["place", "transition", "arc", "inhibit"], true)) {
            bad("unknown definition " . $cmd);
        }
        if (
            !match ($cmd) {
                "place" => $n === 2 || $n === 3,
                "transition" => $n === 1 || $n === 2,
                default => $n === 3,
            }
        ) {
            bad("wrong number of arguments");
        }
        $a = $w[1];
        if ($cmd === "place" || $cmd === "transition") {
            if (in_array($a, $this->p, true) || in_array($a, $this->t, true)) {
                bad("duplicate name " . $a);
            }
            if ($cmd === "place") {
                if ($n === 3 && (int) $w[2] > (int) $w[3]) {
                    bad("tokens exceed capacity of " . $a);
                }
                $this->p[] = $a;
                $this->initial[] = (int) $w[2];
                $this->cap[] = $n === 3 ? (int) $w[3] : 0;
            } else {
                $this->t[] = $a;
                $this->priority[] = $n === 2 ? (int) $w[2] : 0;
            }
        } elseif ($cmd === "arc") {
            $b = $w[2];
            foreach ([$a, $b] as $x) {
                if (!in_array($x, $this->p, true) && !in_array($x, $this->t, true)) {
                    bad("unknown node " . $x);
                }
            }
            $pa = array_search($a, $this->p, true);
            $pb = array_search($b, $this->p, true);
            if (($pa !== false) === ($pb !== false)) {
                bad("arc must connect a place and a transition");
            }
            $p = $pa !== false ? $pa : $pb;
            $t = array_search($pa !== false ? $b : $a, $this->t, true);
            $field = $pa !== false ? "pre" : "post";
            if ($this->{$field}[$p][$t]) {
                bad("duplicate arc $a $b");
            }
            $this->{$field}[$p][$t] = (int) $w[3];
            ++$this->arcs;
        } else {
            $p = array_search($a, $this->p, true);
            $t = array_search($w[2], $this->t, true);
            if ($p === false) {
                bad("unknown place " . $a);
            }
            if ($t === false) {
                bad("unknown transition " . $w[2]);
            }
            if ($this->inh[$p][$t]) {
                bad("duplicate inhibitor $a {$w[2]}");
            }
            $this->inh[$p][$t] = (int) $w[3];
            ++$this->inhibitors;
        }
    }
    public function reason(array $m, int $t): string
    {
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            if ($m[$p] >= 0 && $m[$p] < $this->pre[$p][$t]) {
                return "insufficient tokens in " . $name;
            }
        }
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            if ($this->inh[$p][$t] && ($m[$p] < 0 || $m[$p] >= $this->inh[$p][$t])) {
                return "inhibited by " . $name;
            }
        }
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            if (
                $this->cap[$p] &&
                ($m[$p] < 0 || $m[$p] - $this->pre[$p][$t] + $this->post[$p][$t] > $this->cap[$p])
            ) {
                return "capacity of " . $name . " exceeded";
            }
        }
        return "";
    }
    public function enabled(array $m): array
    {
        $r = [];
        foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
            if ($this->reason($m, $t) === "") {
                $r[] = $t;
            }
        }
        return $r;
    }
    public function fire(array $m, int $t): array
    {
        foreach ($m as $p => $v) {
            if ($v >= 0) {
                $m[$p] += $this->post[$p][$t] - $this->pre[$p][$t];
            }
        }
        return $m;
    }
    public function commit(int $t): void
    {
        $this->history[] = $this->current;
        $this->current = $this->fire($this->current, $t);
    }
    public function names(array $ts): array
    {
        return array_map(fn($t) => $this->t[$t], $ts);
    }
    public function graph(array $start, int $limit, ?array $target = null): array
    {
        $g = [
            "states" => [$start],
            "parent" => [-1],
            "via" => [-1],
            "edges" => [[]],
            "found" => -1,
            "aborted" => false,
        ];
        $index = [implode(",", $start) => 0];
        $matches = static function ($m) use ($target) {
            if ($target === null) {
                return false;
            }
            foreach ($m as $p => $v) {
                if ($v < $target[$p][0] || ($target[$p][1] >= 0 && $v !== $target[$p][1])) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        };
        if ($matches($start)) {
            $g["found"] = 0;
            return $g;
        }
        for ($q = 0; $q < count($g["states"]); ++$q) {
            foreach ($this->enabled($g["states"][$q]) as $t) {
                $m = $this->fire($g["states"][$q], $t);
                $key = implode(",", $m);
                if (!array_key_exists($key, $index)) {
                    if (count($g["states"]) === $limit) {
                        $g["aborted"] = true;
                        return $g;
                    }
                    $k = count($g["states"]);
                    $index[$key] = $k;
                    $g["states"][] = $m;
                    $g["parent"][] = $q;
                    $g["via"][] = $t;
                    $g["edges"][] = [];
                    if ($matches($m)) {
                        $g["found"] = $k;
                        return $g;
                    }
                } else {
                    $k = $index[$key];
                }
                $g["edges"][$q][] = [$t, $k];
            };
        }
        return $g;
    }
    public function path(array $g, int $k): array
    {
        $r = [];
        while ($g["parent"][$k] >= 0) {
            $r[] = $g["via"][$k];
            $k = $g["parent"][$k];
        }
        return array_reverse($r);
    }
    public function reach(int $limit, bool $display): void
    {
        $g = $this->graph($this->current, $limit);
        if ($g["aborted"]) {
            echo "reachability graph limit $limit exceeded\n";
            return;
        }
        $states = $g["states"];
        $edges = $g["edges"];
        $n = count($states);
        if ($display) {
            foreach ($states as $i => $m) {
                $a = [];
                foreach ($edges[$i] as [$t, $k]) {
                    $a[] = $this->t[$t] . "->M" . $k;
                }
                echo "M" . $i . " " . mark($m) . ": " . ($a ? implode(" ", $a) : "dead") . "\n";
            }
            return;
        }
        $adj = array_map(fn($e) => array_column($e, 1), $edges);
        $closure = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; ++$i) {
            $closure[] = visit($adj, $i);
        }
        $comp = array_fill(0, $n, -1);
        $count = 0;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; ++$i) {
            if ($comp[$i] < 0) {
                for ($j = $i; $j < $n; ++$j) {
                    if ($closure[$i][$j] && $closure[$j][$i]) {
                        $comp[$j] = $count;
                    }
                }
                ++$count;
            }
        }
        $terminal = array_fill(0, $count, true);
        $home = array_fill(0, $n, true);
        $maximum = array_fill(0, count($this->p), 0);
        $dead = [];
        $edgeCount = 0;
        $persistent = true;
        foreach ($states as $i => $m) {
            if (!$edges[$i]) {
                $dead[] = $i;
            }
            $edgeCount += count($edges[$i]);
            foreach ($m as $p => $v) {
                $maximum[$p] = max($maximum[$p], $v);
            }
            for ($j = 0; $j < $n; ++$j) {
                $home[$j] = $home[$j] && $closure[$i][$j];
            }
            foreach ($edges[$i] as [$t, $k]) {
                if ($comp[$i] !== $comp[$k]) {
                    $terminal[$comp[$i]] = false;
                }
                foreach ($edges[$i] as [$u, $v]) {
                    if ($t !== $u && $this->reason($states[$k], $u) !== "") {
                        $persistent = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        echo "reachable markings: $n\nedges: $edgeCount\ncomponents: $count (terminal " .
            count(array_filter($terminal)) .
            ")\ndead markings: " .
            count($dead) .
            "\n";
        foreach ($dead as $i) {
            $a = $this->names($this->path($g, $i));
            echo "  M" .
                $i .
                " " .
                mark($states[$i]) .
                " path " .
                ($a ? implode(" ", $a) : "empty") .
                "\n";
        }
        $bound = max($maximum);
        echo "max tokens: " . mark($maximum) . "\nbound: $bound\nsafe: " . yn($bound <= 1) . "\n";
        echo "home markings: " .
            count(array_filter($home)) .
            "\nreversible: " .
            yn($home[0]) .
            "\npersistent: " .
            yn($persistent) .
            "\n";
        $levels = [];
        foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
            $present = array_fill(0, $count, false);
            $used = $cycle = false;
            foreach ($edges as $i => $e) {
                foreach ($e as [$u, $v]) {
                    if ($u === $t) {
                        $used = true;
                        $present[$comp[$i]] = true;
                        if ($comp[$i] === $comp[$v]) {
                            $cycle = true;
                        }
                    }
                };
            }
            $live = true;
            foreach ($terminal as $c => $v) {
                if ($v && !$present[$c]) {
                    $live = false;
                }
            }
            $levels[] = $name . "=" . ($live ? "L4" : ($cycle ? "L3" : ($used ? "L1" : "L0")));
        }
        echo "liveness: " . implode(" ", $levels) . "\n";
    }
    public function cover(int $limit): void
    {
        $states = [$this->current];
        $parents = [-1];
        $via = [-1];
        $old = [false];
        $dead = [false];
        $rank = fn($v) => $v < 0 ? PHP_INT_MAX : $v;
        for ($q = 0; $q < count($states); ++$q) {
            if ($old[$q]) {
                continue;
            }
            $es = $this->enabled($states[$q]);
            $dead[$q] = !$es;
            $anc = [];
            for ($a = $q; $a >= 0; $a = $parents[$a]) {
                $anc[] = $a;
            }
            $anc = array_reverse($anc);
            foreach ($es as $t) {
                $m = $this->fire($states[$q], $t);
                foreach ($anc as $a) {
                    $ge = true;
                    $gt = false;
                    foreach ($m as $p => $v) {
                        $ge = $ge && $rank($v) >= $rank($states[$a][$p]);
                        $gt = $gt || $rank($v) > $rank($states[$a][$p]);
                    }
                    if ($ge && $gt) {
                        foreach ($m as $p => $v) {
                            if (!$this->cap[$p] && $rank($v) > $rank($states[$a][$p])) {
                                $m[$p] = -1;
                            }
                        };
                    }
                }
                if (count($states) === $limit) {
                    echo "coverability tree limit $limit exceeded\n";
                    return;
                }
                $old[] = in_array($m, $states, true);
                $states[] = $m;
                $parents[] = $q;
                $via[] = $t;
                $dead[] = false;
            }
        }
        echo "coverability tree nodes: " . count($states) . "\n";
        $maximum = array_fill(0, count($this->p), 0);
        foreach ($states as $i => $m) {
            echo "  " .
                $i .
                " " .
                mark($m) .
                " " .
                ($i ? "<- " . $parents[$i] . " " . $this->t[$via[$i]] : "root") .
                ($old[$i] ? " old" : "") .
                ($dead[$i] ? " dead" : "") .
                "\n";
            foreach ($m as $p => $v) {
                if ($rank($v) > $rank($maximum[$p])) {
                    $maximum[$p] = $v;
                }
            }
        }
        $names = [];
        foreach ($maximum as $p => $v) {
            if ($v < 0) {
                $names[] = $this->p[$p];
            }
        }
        echo "bounds: " . mark($maximum) . "\nunbounded: " . listed($names) . "\n";
    }
    public function sets(bool $trap): array
    {
        $all = [];
        for ($mask = 1; $mask < 1 << count($this->p); ++$mask) {
            $valid = true;
            foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                $in = $out = false;
                foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
                    if ($mask & (1 << $p)) {
                        $in = $in || $this->post[$p][$t] > 0;
                        $out = $out || $this->pre[$p][$t] > 0;
                    }
                }
                if ($trap ? $out && !$in : $in && !$out) {
                    $valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ($valid) {
                $all[] = $mask;
            }
        }
        $r = [];
        foreach ($all as $m) {
            $minimal = true;
            foreach ($all as $s) {
                if ($s !== $m && ($s & $m) === $s) {
                    $minimal = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ($minimal) {
                $r[] = $m;
            }
        }
        $bits = function ($m) {
            $a = [];
            foreach ($this->p as $i => $name) {
                if ($m & (1 << $i)) {
                    $a[] = $i;
                }
            }
            return $a;
        };
        usort($r, function ($a, $b) use ($bits) {
            $x = $bits($a);
            $y = $bits($b);
            return count($x) <=> count($y) ?: $x <=> $y;
        });
        return $r;
    }
    public function setText(int $mask): string
    {
        $a = [];
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            if ($mask & (1 << $p)) {
                $a[] = $name;
            }
        }
        return "{" . implode(",", $a) . "}";
    }
    public function realize(array $counts): ?array
    {
        $used = array_fill(0, count($counts), 0);
        $stack = [$this->current];
        $choices = [0];
        $path = [];
        $seen = [];
        $total = array_sum($counts);
        while ($stack) {
            $d = count($path);
            if ($d === $total) {
                return $path;
            }
            $chosen = -1;
            for ($t = $choices[$d]; $t < count($counts); ++$t) {
                $choices[$d] = $t + 1;
                if ($used[$t] >= $counts[$t] || $this->reason($stack[$d], $t) !== "") {
                    continue;
                }
                ++$used[$t];
                $key = implode(",", $used);
                --$used[$t];
                if (isset($seen[$key])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $seen[$key] = true;
                $chosen = $t;
                break;
            }
            if ($chosen >= 0) {
                ++$used[$chosen];
                $path[] = $chosen;
                $stack[] = $this->fire($stack[$d], $chosen);
                $choices[] = 0;
            } else {
                array_pop($stack);
                array_pop($choices);
                if ($path) {
                    --$used[array_pop($path)];
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    public function invariants(bool $transpose): void
    {
        $a = [];
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            $r = [];
            foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                $r[] = $this->post[$p][$t] - $this->pre[$p][$t];
            }
            $a[] = $r;
        }
        if ($transpose) {
            $b = [];
            foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                $b[] = array_column($a, $t);
            }
            $a = $b;
        }
        $f = flows($a);
        $names = $transpose ? $this->t : $this->p;
        $bounds = array_fill(0, count($names), -1);
        $covered = array_fill(0, count($names), false);
        echo ($transpose ? "T" : "P") . "-semiflows: " . count($f) . "\n";
        foreach ($f as $c) {
            $terms = [];
            $value = 0;
            foreach ($c as $i => $v) {
                if ($v) {
                    $terms[] = ($v === 1 ? "" : $v . "*") . $names[$i];
                    $covered[$i] = true;
                    if (!$transpose) {
                        $value += $v * $this->current[$i];
                    }
                }
            }
            echo "  " . implode(" + ", $terms);
            if ($transpose) {
                $path = $this->realize($c);
                echo ": " .
                    ($path === null
                        ? "not realizable"
                        : "realizable " . implode(" ", $this->names($path))) .
                    "\n";
            } else {
                echo " = " . $value . "\n";
                foreach ($c as $p => $v) {
                    if ($v) {
                        $b = intdiv($value, $v);
                        $bounds[$p] = $bounds[$p] < 0 ? $b : min($bounds[$p], $b);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!$transpose) {
            echo "bounds: (" .
                implode(",", array_map(fn($v) => $v < 0 ? "-" : (string) $v, $bounds)) .
                ")\n";
        }
        echo ($transpose ? "consistent: " : "conservative: ") .
            yn(!in_array(false, $covered, true)) .
            "\n";
    }
    public function classify(): void
    {
        $ordinary = $pure = $sm = $mg = $fc = $efc = true;
        $inputs = array_fill(0, count($this->t), []);
        $outputs = array_fill(0, count($this->p), []);
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                $ordinary = $ordinary && $this->pre[$p][$t] <= 1 && $this->post[$p][$t] <= 1;
                $pure = $pure && !($this->pre[$p][$t] && $this->post[$p][$t]);
                if ($this->pre[$p][$t]) {
                    $inputs[$t][] = $p;
                    $outputs[$p][] = $t;
                }
            };
        }
        foreach ($inputs as $t => $a) {
            $n = 0;
            foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
                $n += (int) ($this->post[$p][$t] > 0);
            }
            $sm = $sm && count($a) === 1 && $n === 1;
        }
        foreach ($outputs as $p => $a) {
            $n = 0;
            foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                $n += (int) ($this->post[$p][$t] > 0);
            }
            $mg = $mg && count($a) === 1 && $n === 1;
            foreach ($a as $t) {
                if (count($a) !== 1 && count($inputs[$t]) !== 1) {
                    $fc = false;
                }
            }
            foreach ($outputs as $b) {
                if (array_intersect($a, $b) && $a !== $b) {
                    $efc = false;
                }
            }
        }
        $sm = $sm && $ordinary;
        $mg = $mg && $ordinary;
        $fc = $fc && $ordinary;
        $efc = $efc && $ordinary;
        foreach (
            [
                "ordinary" => $ordinary,
                "pure" => $pure,
                "state machine" => $sm,
                "marked graph" => $mg,
                "free choice" => $fc,
                "extended free choice" => $efc,
            ]
            as $label => $v
        ) {
            echo $label . ": " . yn($v) . "\n";
        }
        $verdict = !$fc ? "not applicable" : (count($this->p) > 12 ? "too many places" : "holds");
        if ($fc && count($this->p) <= 12) {
            $traps = $this->sets(true);
            foreach ($this->sets(false) as $s) {
                $holds = false;
                foreach ($traps as $q) {
                    if (($s & $q) === $q) {
                        foreach ($this->current as $p => $v) {
                            if ($v > 0 && $q & (1 << $p)) {
                                $holds = true;
                            }
                        };
                    }
                }
                if (!$holds) {
                    $verdict = "fails at " . $this->setText($s);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        echo "commoner: " . $verdict . "\n";
    }
    public function workflow(int $limit): void
    {
        $sources = $sinks = [];
        $P = count($this->p);
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            $in = $out = false;
            foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                $in = $in || $this->post[$p][$t] > 0;
                $out = $out || $this->pre[$p][$t] > 0;
            }
            if (!$in) {
                $sources[] = $p;
            }
            if (!$out) {
                $sinks[] = $p;
            }
        }
        if (count($sources) !== 1) {
            echo "workflow: no (" . count($sources) . " source places)\n";
            return;
        }
        if (count($sinks) !== 1) {
            echo "workflow: no (" . count($sinks) . " sink places)\n";
            return;
        }
        $i = $sources[0];
        $o = $sinks[0];
        $names = array_merge($this->p, $this->t);
        $adj = $rev = array_fill(0, count($names), []);
        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
            foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                if ($this->pre[$p][$t]) {
                    $adj[$p][] = $P + $t;
                    $rev[$P + $t][] = $p;
                }
                if ($this->post[$p][$t]) {
                    $adj[$P + $t][] = $p;
                    $rev[$p][] = $P + $t;
                }
            };
        }
        $f = visit($adj, $i);
        $b = visit($rev, $o);
        foreach ($names as $v => $name) {
            if (!$f[$v] || !$b[$v]) {
                echo "workflow: no ($name is not on a path from {$this->p[$i]} to {$this->p[$o]})\n";
                return;
            }
        }
        echo "workflow: source {$this->p[$i]} sink {$this->p[$o]}\n";
        $start = $goal = array_fill(0, $P, 0);
        $start[$i] = 1;
        $goal[$o] = 1;
        $g = $this->graph($start, $limit);
        if ($g["aborted"]) {
            echo "reachability graph limit $limit exceeded\n";
            return;
        }
        $end = array_search($goal, $g["states"], true);
        $rev = array_fill(0, count($g["states"]), []);
        $used = array_fill(0, count($this->t), false);
        $proper = true;
        foreach ($g["states"] as $u => $m) {
            if ($m[$o] >= 1 && $m !== $goal) {
                $proper = false;
            }
            foreach ($g["edges"][$u] as [$t, $v]) {
                $rev[$v][] = $u;
                $used[$t] = true;
            }
        }
        $option = $end !== false && !in_array(false, visit($rev, $end), true);
        $live = !in_array(false, $used, true);
        echo "option to complete: " .
            yn($option) .
            "\nproper completion: " .
            yn($proper) .
            "\nno dead transitions: " .
            yn($live) .
            "\nsound: " .
            yn($option && $proper && $live) .
            "\n";
    }
    public function execute(array $w): void
    {
        $cmd = $w[0];
        $arity = [
            "MARKING" => 0,
            "RESET" => 0,
            "SET" => 2,
            "ENABLED" => 0,
            "FIRE" => -1,
            "UNDO" => 1,
            "SIMULATE" => 3,
            "CONFLICTS" => 0,
            "REACH" => 1,
            "GRAPH" => 1,
            "COVER" => 1,
            "PATH" => 2,
            "INCIDENCE" => 0,
            "PINV" => 0,
            "TINV" => 0,
            "SIPHONS" => 0,
            "TRAPS" => 0,
            "CLASSIFY" => 0,
            "WORKFLOW" => 1,
            "SHOW" => 0,
        ];
        if (!array_key_exists($cmd, $arity)) {
            bad("unknown command " . $cmd);
        }
        if ($arity[$cmd] < 0 ? count($w) < 2 : count($w) !== $arity[$cmd] + 1) {
            bad("wrong number of arguments");
        }
        $limit = 0;
        if (in_array($cmd, ["REACH", "GRAPH", "COVER", "PATH", "WORKFLOW"], true)) {
            $limit = number($w[1], 1, 2000);
            if ($limit < 0) {
                bad("invalid limit " . $w[1]);
            }
        }
        switch ($cmd) {
            case "MARKING":
            case "RESET":
                if ($cmd === "RESET") {
                    $this->current = $this->initial;
                    $this->history = [];
                }
                echo "marking " . mark($this->current) . "\n";
                break;
            case "SET":
                $p = array_search($w[1], $this->p, true);
                if ($p === false) {
                    bad("unknown place " . $w[1]);
                }
                $v = number($w[2], 0, 999);
                if ($v < 0) {
                    bad("invalid tokens " . $w[2]);
                }
                if ($this->cap[$p] && $v > $this->cap[$p]) {
                    bad("tokens exceed capacity of " . $w[1]);
                }
                $this->current[$p] = $v;
                $this->history = [];
                echo "marking " . mark($this->current) . "\n";
                break;
            case "ENABLED":
                echo "enabled: " . listed($this->names($this->enabled($this->current))) . "\n";
                break;
            case "FIRE":
                $ts = [];
                foreach (array_slice($w, 1) as $name) {
                    $t = array_search($name, $this->t, true);
                    if ($t === false) {
                        bad("unknown transition " . $name);
                    }
                    $ts[] = $t;
                }
                foreach ($ts as $i => $t) {
                    $r = $this->reason($this->current, $t);
                    if ($r !== "") {
                        echo "step " .
                            ($i + 1) .
                            ": {$this->t[$t]} not enabled ($r) at " .
                            mark($this->current) .
                            "\n";
                        return;
                    }
                    $this->commit($t);
                }
                echo "fired " . count($ts) . " -> " . mark($this->current) . "\n";
                break;
            case "UNDO":
                $k = number($w[1], 1, 1000);
                if ($k < 0) {
                    bad("invalid count " . $w[1]);
                }
                $h = count($this->history);
                if ($k > $h) {
                    bad("cannot undo $k: history size $h");
                }
                $this->current = $this->history[$h - $k];
                $this->history = array_slice($this->history, 0, $h - $k);
                echo "marking " . mark($this->current) . "\n";
                break;
            case "SIMULATE":
                $steps = number($w[1], 1, 1000);
                $x = number($w[2], 1, 2147483646);
                if ($steps < 0) {
                    bad("invalid steps " . $w[1]);
                }
                if ($x < 0) {
                    bad("invalid seed " . $w[2]);
                }
                if (!in_array($w[3], ["PRIORITY", "RANDOM"], true)) {
                    bad("invalid mode " . $w[3]);
                }
                $counts = array_fill(0, count($this->t), 0);
                for ($done = 0; $done < $steps; ++$done) {
                    $e = $this->enabled($this->current);
                    if (!$e) {
                        echo "dead (steps=$done)\n";
                        break;
                    }
                    $t = $e[0];
                    if ($w[3] === "RANDOM") {
                        $x = ($x * 48271) % 2147483647;
                        $t = $e[$x % count($e)];
                    } else {
                        foreach ($e as $u) {
                            if ($this->priority[$u] > $this->priority[$t]) {
                                $t = $u;
                            }
                        };
                    }
                    $this->commit($t);
                    ++$counts[$t];
                    echo "step " .
                        ($done + 1) .
                        ": " .
                        $this->t[$t] .
                        " -> " .
                        mark($this->current) .
                        "\n";
                }
                if ($done === $steps) {
                    echo "completed (steps=$steps)\n";
                }
                $a = [];
                foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                    $a[] = $name . "=" . $counts[$t];
                }
                echo "counts: " . implode(" ", $a) . "\n";
                break;
            case "CONFLICTS":
                $s = $e = [];
                for ($u = 0; $u < count($this->t); ++$u) {
                    for ($v = $u + 1; $v < count($this->t); ++$v) {
                        $pair = $this->t[$u] . "/" . $this->t[$v];
                        $conflict = false;
                        foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
                            if ($this->pre[$p][$u] && $this->pre[$p][$v]) {
                                $conflict = true;
                            }
                        }
                        if ($conflict) {
                            $s[] = $pair;
                        }
                        if (
                            $this->reason($this->current, $u) === "" &&
                            $this->reason($this->current, $v) === "" &&
                            ($this->reason($this->fire($this->current, $u), $v) !== "" ||
                                $this->reason($this->fire($this->current, $v), $u) !== "")
                        ) {
                            $e[] = $pair;
                        }
                    };
                }
                echo "structural: " . listed($s) . "\neffective: " . listed($e) . "\n";
                break;
            case "REACH":
            case "GRAPH":
                $this->reach($limit, $cmd === "GRAPH");
                break;
            case "COVER":
                $this->cover($limit);
                break;
            case "PATH":
                $entries = explode(",", $w[2]);
                if (count($entries) !== count($this->p)) {
                    bad("target needs " . count($this->p) . " entries");
                }
                $target = [];
                foreach ($entries as $s) {
                    if ($s === "*") {
                        $target[] = [0, -1];
                        continue;
                    }
                    $plus = str_ends_with($s, "+");
                    $v = number($plus ? substr($s, 0, -1) : $s, 0, 9999999999);
                    if ($v < 0) {
                        bad("invalid target entry " . $s);
                    }
                    $target[] = [$v, $plus ? -1 : $v];
                }
                $g = $this->graph($this->current, $limit, $target);
                if ($g["found"] >= 0) {
                    $a = $this->names($this->path($g, $g["found"]));
                    echo "reached " .
                        mark($g["states"][$g["found"]]) .
                        " length=" .
                        count($a) .
                        ($a ? ": " . implode(" ", $a) : "") .
                        "\n";
                } elseif ($g["aborted"]) {
                    echo "search limit $limit exceeded\n";
                } else {
                    echo "unreachable (markings explored: " . count($g["states"]) . ")\n";
                }
                break;
            case "INCIDENCE":
                $rows = [array_merge([""], $this->t)];
                foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
                    $r = [$name];
                    foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                        $r[] = (string) ($this->post[$p][$t] - $this->pre[$p][$t]);
                    }
                    $rows[] = $r;
                }
                $width = array_fill(0, count($this->t) + 1, 0);
                foreach ($rows as $r) {
                    foreach ($r as $i => $s) {
                        $width[$i] = max($width[$i], strlen($s));
                    };
                }
                foreach ($rows as $r) {
                    $a = [];
                    foreach ($r as $i => $s) {
                        $a[] = str_pad($s, $width[$i], " ", $i ? STR_PAD_LEFT : STR_PAD_RIGHT);
                    }
                    echo rtrim(implode("  ", $a)) . "\n";
                }
                break;
            case "PINV":
            case "TINV":
                $this->invariants($cmd === "TINV");
                break;
            case "SIPHONS":
            case "TRAPS":
                if (count($this->p) > 12) {
                    bad("more than 12 places");
                }
                $sets = $this->sets($cmd === "TRAPS");
                echo "minimal " .
                    ($cmd === "TRAPS" ? "traps" : "siphons") .
                    ": " .
                    count($sets) .
                    "\n";
                foreach ($sets as $s) {
                    $tokens = 0;
                    foreach ($this->current as $p => $v) {
                        if ($s & (1 << $p)) {
                            $tokens += $v;
                        }
                    }
                    echo "  " . $this->setText($s) . " tokens=" . $tokens . "\n";
                }
                break;
            case "CLASSIFY":
                $this->classify();
                break;
            case "WORKFLOW":
                $this->workflow($limit);
                break;
            case "SHOW":
                foreach ($this->p as $p => $name) {
                    echo "place $name tokens={$this->initial[$p]} capacity=" .
                        ($this->cap[$p] ?: "none") .
                        "\n";
                }
                foreach ($this->t as $t => $name) {
                    $lists = [];
                    foreach ([$this->pre, $this->post, $this->inh] as $matrix) {
                        $a = [];
                        foreach ($this->p as $p => $pn) {
                            if ($matrix[$p][$t]) {
                                $a[] = $pn . ":" . $matrix[$p][$t];
                            }
                        }
                        $lists[] = $a ? implode(",", $a) : "-";
                    }
                    echo "transition $name priority={$this->priority[$t]} pre={$lists[0]} post={$lists[1]} inhibit={$lists[2]}\n";
                }
                break;
        }
    }
}
$blocks = (int) trim(fgets(STDIN));
for ($b = 0; $b < $blocks; ++$b) {
    $net = new Net(explode(" ", trim(fgets(STDIN)))[1]);
    while (($line = rtrim(fgets(STDIN), "\r\n")) !== "END NET") {
        try {
            $net->define(explode(" ", $line));
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            echo "error: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
        }
    }
    $net->current = $net->initial;
    echo "net {$net->name}: places=" .
        count($net->p) .
        " transitions=" .
        count($net->t) .
        " arcs={$net->arcs} inhibitors={$net->inhibitors}\n";
    $n = (int) trim(fgets(STDIN));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; ++$i) {
        try {
            $net->execute(explode(" ", rtrim(fgets(STDIN), "\r\n")));
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            echo "error: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
        }
    }
}
